sourcedFrom: THUNDER CHICKEN BY Q™ / TRASH PANDA BY Q™ / CHERRY BOMB™ FAST-ATTACH MUZZLE BRAKE BY Q™ — NOT PRINTED — this sheet carries no revision number (unlike the ERECTOR and NELSON sheets, which print REV 1.0) (2021)
cleanIntro: The long half of Q's fast-attach 7.62 pair: 8.1 inches and 14.7 oz of titanium, riding on a Cherry Bomb muzzle brake rather than on the barrel threads. Q publishes a removal procedure for it and no disassembly at all, so the field strip ends where the can leaves the brake. The sheet covers the Thunder Chicken and the Trash Panda together — the ratings are shared, the dimensions are not.

steps.title: Clear the host before the can comes off
steps.action: Magazine out, action open, then inspect the chamber and magazine well by eye and by finger. Q asks for both, and asks for them before the silencer is disturbed rather than after. On a semi-auto host the bolt must be locked back for that inspection to mean anything.
steps.prose: Breaking a fast-attach joint takes a wrench and a firm grip on the rifle. That is not a position to be in with a live chamber.
steps.quote: BEFORE REMOVING ANY SILENCER FROM ITS HOST, REMOVE THE MAGAZINE FROM YOUR FIREARM, MAKE SURE THE ACTION IS OPEN AND THE FIREARM IS UNLOADED BY PERFORMING A PHYSICAL AND VISUAL INSPECTION OF THE CHAMBER AND MAGAZINE WELL.
steps.cite: THUNDER CHICKEN BY Q™ / TRASH PANDA BY Q™ / CHERRY BOMB™ FAST-ATTACH MUZZLE BRAKE BY Q™ — NOT PRINTED — this sheet carries no revision number (unlike the ERECTOR and NELSON sheets, which print REV 1.0) — REMOVAL, p.1

steps.title: This sheet is half the paperwork
steps.action: Q states that the can ships with an accompanying FINE PRINT sheet and that both must be read before use. It also gives no clearing procedure for your rifle, because it cannot — go to the host firearm's own operating manual for that, and use this sheet only for what it actually documents, which is the suppressor and its brake.
steps.prose: One page of tech data is not an owner's manual. Read it as a specification sheet with warnings, which is what it is.
steps.caution: The FINE PRINT sheet is part of the documentation, not an extra.
steps.quote: BEFORE USING THIS SILENCER: BE CERTAIN YOU HAVE READ AND UNDERSTAND THIS MANUAL AND THE ACCOMPANYING “FINE PRINT” SHEET.
steps.cite: THUNDER CHICKEN BY Q™ / TRASH PANDA BY Q™ / CHERRY BOMB™ FAST-ATTACH MUZZLE BRAKE BY Q™ — NOT PRINTED — this sheet carries no revision number (unlike the ERECTOR and NELSON sheets, which print REV 1.0) — MORE LAWYER SHIT, p.1

steps.title: Thunder Chicken ceiling — 7.62mm or smaller projectiles
steps.action: Check the host's bore diameter against the rating. Q rates the Thunder Chicken and the Trash Panda for 7.62mm or smaller projectiles, and the SPECS block under the Thunder Chicken's name reads 7.62 NATO, 300 BLK and 300 WM. Larger than 7.62mm is outside the design whatever the chambering is called.
steps.prose: The Thunder Chicken's own numbers on this sheet are 8.1 in, 1.75 in diameter and 14.7 oz. The 6.9 in / 11.8 oz figures a few lines away belong to the Trash Panda and are not yours.
steps.quote: THE THUNDER CHICKEN & TRASH PANDA SILENCERS ARE FOR USE WITH 7.62MM OR SMALLER PROJECTILES.
steps.cite: THUNDER CHICKEN BY Q™ / TRASH PANDA BY Q™ / CHERRY BOMB™ FAST-ATTACH MUZZLE BRAKE BY Q™ — NOT PRINTED — this sheet carries no revision number (unlike the ERECTOR and NELSON sheets, which print REV 1.0) — MORE LAWYER SHIT, p.1

steps.title: Factory SAAMI or C.I.P. ammunition only
steps.action: Q restricts this can to factory certified SAAMI or C.I.P. ammunition. Reloads and remanufactured ammunition are outside that, and Q lists improper or poor quality ammunition among the causes of a baffle strike — which on a titanium tube is a scrapped can rather than a repair.
steps.prose: Subsonic 300 BLK is the usual offender here, because a heavy bullet that fails to stabilise tumbles before it ever reaches the front cap.
steps.quote: ONLY USE FACTORY CERTIFIED SAAMI/C.I.P. AMMUNITION WITH THIS SILENCER by Q.
steps.cite: THUNDER CHICKEN BY Q™ / TRASH PANDA BY Q™ / CHERRY BOMB™ FAST-ATTACH MUZZLE BRAKE BY Q™ — NOT PRINTED — this sheet carries no revision number (unlike the ERECTOR and NELSON sheets, which print REV 1.0) — MORE LAWYER SHIT, p.1

steps.title: Give it a minute before you touch it
steps.action: Straight off a string the can is hot enough to burn through a glove's worth of hesitation. Q's instruction is to wait. Titanium at 8.1 inches of length holds heat well past the point where it stops looking hot, and the wrench flats are on the tube itself.
steps.prose: The same warning is why Q tells you not to stick a finger straight into a just-fired chamber. Both surfaces lie about their temperature. The manual prints an ellipsis inside this sentence; the citation is cut to the contiguous side so nothing is elided by us. Its other half reads: "THAT SHIT GETS HOT.".
steps.quote: IF YOU JUST FINISHED SHOOTING, I’D WAIT A MINUTE
steps.cite: THUNDER CHICKEN BY Q™ / TRASH PANDA BY Q™ / CHERRY BOMB™ FAST-ATTACH MUZZLE BRAKE BY Q™ — NOT PRINTED — this sheet carries no revision number (unlike the ERECTOR and NELSON sheets, which print REV 1.0) — REMOVAL, p.1
steps.warn: Wait, or use a cover or gloves.

steps.title: Unthread the Thunder Chicken from the Cherry Bomb
steps.action: Use the 1 inch SAE flats machined into the rear of the can, or the 3/4 inch flats at the front if the rear ones are buried under a handguard, and turn counter-clockwise. Q designs those flats for install and removal specifically, so the load goes into the flats and not into the tube wall.
steps.prose: Q's whole removal instruction is two lines: turn it off, and you are done. On this can that is literally the end of the strip.
steps.caution: Never put a pipe wrench or a strap on the tube body.
steps.quote: 1.Righty tighty. The Thunder Chicken and Trash Panda silencers feature 1 inch SAE ﬂats on the rear. We recommend you use these for install and removal. They also feature 3/4 SAE ﬂats on the front for silencers installed under a handguard.
steps.cite: THUNDER CHICKEN BY Q™ / TRASH PANDA BY Q™ / CHERRY BOMB™ FAST-ATTACH MUZZLE BRAKE BY Q™ — NOT PRINTED — this sheet carries no revision number (unlike the ERECTOR and NELSON sheets, which print REV 1.0) — SILENCER INSTALLATION, p.1

steps.title: Leave the Cherry Bomb on the barrel
steps.action: The brake is the mount, and it is meant to stay put. It goes on with Rocksett on the barrel threads and is torqued to 20-30 lbs with a 1/2 inch socket on its front flats. Every time you break that joint you disturb the concentricity the can borrows from it, so it comes off only when the barrel does.
steps.prose: Q also bars anything between the brake and the shoulder: no washers, no shims, no jam nuts, because the Cherry Bomb is not timed and a shim only introduces a tilt.
steps.quote: 5.Using a 1/2 inch socket, tighten the Cherry Bomb clockwise onto your host ﬁrearm to 20-30 lbs.
steps.cite: THUNDER CHICKEN BY Q™ / TRASH PANDA BY Q™ / CHERRY BOMB™ FAST-ATTACH MUZZLE BRAKE BY Q™ — NOT PRINTED — this sheet carries no revision number (unlike the ERECTOR and NELSON sheets, which print REV 1.0) — ASSEMBLY — Cherry Bomb installation, p.1
steps.warn: DO NOT USE WASHERS, SHIMS, OR JAM NUTS WHEN INSTALLING THE CHERRY BOMB ONTO THE HOST BARREL.

steps.title: Scrub the brake taper and the can's matching seat
steps.action: With the can off, clean the Cherry Bomb's taper, shoulder and threads and the matching features inside the rear of the Thunder Chicken. Q ties this directly to alignment — carbon on those faces is what tilts the can off the bore axis. Use solvent-moistened Scotch-Brite or a brass or nylon brush.
steps.prose: Steel tools are barred outright, and on a taper that is not fussiness: a scored taper never seats the same way twice.
steps.caution: DO NOT USE STEEL TOOLS FOR CLEANING.
steps.quote: 1.Clean the Cherry Bomb’s taper / shoulder and threads as well as the corresponding silencer features of any fouling. This will help with alignment of the silencer to the barrel’s axis, ensuring optimal performance.
steps.cite: THUNDER CHICKEN BY Q™ / TRASH PANDA BY Q™ / CHERRY BOMB™ FAST-ATTACH MUZZLE BRAKE BY Q™ — NOT PRINTED — this sheet carries no revision number (unlike the ERECTOR and NELSON sheets, which print REV 1.0) — CLEANING & MAINTENANCE, p.1

steps.title: Field strip complete
steps.action: The Thunder Chicken is off, the Cherry Bomb is still on the barrel, and there is nothing further this can lets you do. Q's sheet has REMOVAL and CLEANING & MAINTENANCE sections and no disassembly section — the tube is not meant to open. If the interior needs work it goes into a copper solvent bath or an ultrasonic cleaner in one piece, and it must be rinsed and fully drained before it is fired again.
steps.prose: Q's own view is that a centrefire rifle can needs much less of this than a rimfire or a pistol can, because the pressure and heat clean it as it runs.
steps.quote: 3. When removed from its liquid bath, rinse and make sure the silencer is fully drained before ﬁring.
steps.cite: THUNDER CHICKEN BY Q™ / TRASH PANDA BY Q™ / CHERRY BOMB™ FAST-ATTACH MUZZLE BRAKE BY Q™ — NOT PRINTED — this sheet carries no revision number (unlike the ERECTOR and NELSON sheets, which print REV 1.0) — CLEANING & MAINTENANCE, p.1
steps.warn: Solvent left standing inside a can is an obstruction.

deepAbsentReason: Q PUBLISHES NO DISASSEMBLY FOR THE THUNDER CHICKEN. The tech-data sheet's only teardown-shaped section is REMOVAL, whose content is unthreading the can from the Cherry Bomb; there is no disassembly section, no baffle count, no end-cap procedure and no torque figure for any internal joint. Q's own EL CAMINO and ERECTOR sheets do print those, which shows the omission here is deliberate rather than an oversight. The published deep-clean is a bath of the assembled can. No teardown is offered because none exists to cite.

cleaning.name: BRAKE AND CAN INTERFACE
tasks: Clean fouling off the Cherry Bomb's taper, shoulder and threads
Clean the matching taper and threads in the rear of the Thunder Chicken
Solvent-moistened Scotch-Brite or a brass or nylon brush only — no steel tools
Confirm the brake is still tight on the barrel before the can goes back on

cleaning.name: EXTERIOR AND FLATS
tasks: Wipe the 1 inch rear flats and 3/4 inch front flats clean so a wrench seats square
Inspect the 1.75 in titanium tube for dents, bulges or blueing that was not there before
Wear eye protection — Q requires PPE for all firearms cleaning and maintenance

cleaning.name: INTERIOR (ASSEMBLED)
tasks: Submerge the whole can in copper solvent or run it in an ultrasonic cleaner
Make sure it is fully drained before firing — trapped solvent is an obstruction

reassembly: Check the Cherry Bomb is seated and tight on the barrel with nothing shimmed under it.
Start the Thunder Chicken onto the brake by hand, clockwise, and feel for a clean thread pickup.
Tighten clockwise onto the Cherry Bomb to 10-15 lbs on the 1 inch rear flats.
Use no thread lock at the silencer-to-brake joint — Q prohibits it on a Quickie fast-attach can.
fncheck: With the can torqued onto the Cherry Bomb, sight down the tube from the muzzle and confirm the exit hole is round, central and unmarked. Check the can does not rock on the brake and shows no cant against the barrel. Q lists a loose suppressor as the number one cause of baffle strikes, so re-check tightness after the first few shots as well as before them.
